access.path: Commercial Content API: POST open.tiktokapis.com/v2/research/adlib/ad/query/ and /v2/research/adlib/advertiser/query/ (scope research.adlib.basic)
access.credential: Client key and secret of an approved research project (client access token)
access.approval: Apply through a form after creating a TikTok for Developers account with an official email; an answer is expected within 2 working days. The product page says the APIs are for 'the public and researchers'
access.cost: No fee at present (Developer Terms V, which per II.5(a) does not apply to CCL data)

regions: EU-27 and EEA (NO, IS, LI). GB and CH are listed under 'Continental Europe'; whether they can be queried is unclear
coverage.adTypes: VIDEO, IMAGES or TEXT; ACTIVE or INACTIVE
coverage.history: While the ad runs, and until one year after it was last shown

dataUse: Developer Terms II.5: CCL data may be used only for 'CCL Purposes', which are supervision of, and research into, emerging risks from online advertising. Competitor intelligence does not obviously fit.
Developer Terms II.1 (personal, non-transferable basis) may still apply. A legal review is needed.
When access ends, all TikTok information must be deleted (VI).
unverified: Rate limits and quotas: not published in the pages read.
The Ad Library website (library.tiktok.com/ads) returned an empty page to our fetcher.
The Get Ad Details and Get Ad Report endpoints were not read. Targeting is documented as a filter, not as a returned field.
decisionForProductOwner: Do not apply for competitor monitoring without legal advice: the terms limit the data to research into advertising risks. It covers EU ads only and has no spend.
